name: LibreTranslate
description: Open-source translation API and web UI — no cloud, no API keys, no telemetry. Supports dozens of language pairs.
compose:
services:
  libretranslate:
    image: libretranslate/libretranslate:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:5000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/home/libretranslate/.local/share/argos-translate
    restart: unless-stopped
